subject: Edge node attestation + private connect evidence request (HelixHealth)
messages:
From: Sara Mendes <sara.mendes@helixhealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Helix — quick ask: regional proof / PrivateLink diagram

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for taking the time yesterday. As part of our security intake for the pilot, InfoSec needs a compact evidence packet that demonstrates:

- Physical/geographic location for processing of EU traffic (we need node/zone names + confirmation that no tokenized payloads leave EU nodes)
- A network diagram showing the PrivateLink/peering path from our VPC to your EU edge zone (redact hostnames as needed)
- Answers to a short CAIQ/SIG subset focused on tenancy, encryption, and key custody (we've highlighted ~12 questions)
- SOC 2 artifact pointer (or a SOC 2 letter) and a contact to validate routing questions during the pilot

Can you send a short packet (PDF + a redacted diagram) by EOD tomorrow? We prefer a single PDF with attachments for our reviewer. If you have a runbook for peering setup and test steps, include that as well.

Attaching our highlighted questionnaire (Helix_Security_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx) — please return the completed items inline or as a PDF.

Appreciate it — Sara
(InfoSec, HelixHealth)

Attachment: Helix_Security_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sara Mendes <sara.mendes@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helix — quick ask: regional proof / PrivateLink diagram

Sara — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble this and return a compact packet. Quick notes:

- Data residency: Redwood will serve EU-bound requests from our eu-west-1 edge cluster; we will include node identifiers and the retention profile used for Helix pilot (no customer request state persisted outside EU nodes).
- Networking: we will provide a redacted network diagram showing PrivateLink + an optional backup via TLS-over-public-egress (only used for control-plane failover).
- Controls: we'll return a CAIQ/SIG subset as a PDF and include a pointer to our SOC 2 report (and contact who can validate).

I'll attach a draft runbook for the peering test so you can see the steps we expect for connectivity validation. We anticipate a final packet within 36–48 hours after a brief internal review.

Let me know if Helix needs proof of a test tunnel (we can run a scheduled smoke test and share pcap-level telemetry redacted for IPs).

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: privatelink-runbook-helix.md (runbook stub)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: redaction + operator contacts for Helix packet

Team — a few items before we publish the packet to Helix: 

- Redact names/hostnames in the network diagram; include zone ids and abstracted subnet masks instead of instance IDs. Use 'eu-edge-01' style labels.
- Ensure KMS/HSM custody language is tight: say 'customer-derived keys supported via external KMS' if we cannot assign Helix a dedicated HSM.
- Include an ops contact for peering validation: ops.networks@redwood.com and escalation: oncall-infra@redwood.com.
- Confirm SOC 2 link: use the hosted reader link (expires 7 days). Karthik, can you confirm the reader link and produce the SIG PDF?

I can do a quick pass on the diagram redaction and collate attachments.

Irene
Senior Security & Compliance Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sara Mendes <sara.mendes@helixhealth.com>, Julian Cortez <julian.cortez@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helix — quick ask: regional proof / PrivateLink diagram

Sara / Julian — attaching the evidence packet for the Helix pilot:

- SIG-answers-helix-20270518.pdf (answers to highlighted CAIQ/SIG subset)
- redacted-network-diagram.svg (abstracted PrivateLink path, zone ids only)
- privatelink-runbook-helix.md (connectivity test steps + expected outputs)

Executive summary up top:
- All EU-bound inference for your pilot will be processed in our eu-west-1 edge pool (zones: eu-edge-01, eu-edge-02). No inference request state or customer prompts are persisted outside EU nodes for this pilot configuration.
- Private connectivity is established via AWS PrivateLink with an advertised VPC endpoint in your account. Control-plane fallback may egress to a regional TLS endpoint only under failover and is logged/alerted.
- Keys: customer keys may be used via an external KMS integration; Redwood does not export raw key material from your tenant-bound HSM.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and sign off if this addresses the pilot intake. If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute validation call (ops + network) and run a connectivity smoke test while monitoring with you.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: SIG-answers-helix-20270518.pdf, redacted-network-diagram.svg, privatelink-runbook-helix.md
